name: Theme Songs
description:
Downloads theme songs for your TV series and saves them as theme.mp3 inside each series folder, which is where Jellyfin's built-in "Play Theme Songs" feature looks.

HOW IT WORKS
A scheduled task sweeps every series nightly at 3:00 AM, and can also fetch a theme the moment a new series is added. For each series it skips anything that already has a theme.mp3, looks up the series' TVDB ID, downloads from tvthemes.plexapp.com at about one request per second, validates the response is a real MP3 rather than the error page a missing theme returns, writes it atomically so an interrupted download cannot leave a half-written file, and triggers a metadata refresh — without which Jellyfin never notices the new file. Series with no theme are remembered and retried on a configurable interval instead of being re-requested nightly; temporary upstream failures are not remembered, so a bad hour cannot mark your library as themeless.

REQUIREMENTS
Jellyfin 10.11 or later, and the server process must have write access to your TV library folders — that is where the files are created. Themes come from tvthemes.plexapp.com, a free third-party service with no SLA that covers TV series only and has gaps for very recent shows.

It never overwrites an existing theme.mp3, never writes an unvalidated file, never touches movies or music, and never deletes anything. Series with no TVDB ID are skipped silently.
overview: Automatically downloads TV theme songs so Jellyfin can play them on series pages.
